sin.name: read-in-a-loop
sin.description: A loop reads one row on each turn.
sin.rule: Read the rows together with find_many before the loop, then work on the held rows. PluginCardReading is the one file left out: it claims one queued card file at a time and the claim holds the file's lock until the next turn, so the agent ids of the cards are not known before the loop.
